title: audit-report
description: Machine-readable companion to docs/sdlc/audit/<id>-audit-report.md. Emitted by the audit sub-agent at docs/sdlc/audit/<id>-findings.json. The Markdown report is the human surface; this JSON is the gate input that commit-and-pr (P1-11) and pre-audit-gate.sh consume.

id.description: Feature / system-change ID. Matches the <id> path component used in docs/sdlc/spec/<id>.md, docs/sdlc/audit/<id>-audit-report.md, etc.

schema_version.description: Bumped when this schema makes a backwards-incompatible change. v1 of audit ships schema_version: 1.

audited_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp at which the report was emitted.

auditor_model.description: The exact Anthropic model ID that ran the audit. Typically 'claude-opus-4-7'. Sonnet/Haiku are FORBIDDEN per README.md 'Model selection' (Fansipan absolute rule + audit-quality requirement).

diff_range.description: The exact diff range audited. Default 'main...HEAD'. Recorded so a re-audit can reproduce the input.

dimensions_run.description: Which severity dimensions the auditor ran. Default both.

verdict.description: PASS = mergeable. BLOCK = at least one CRITICAL or HIGH finding, OR a MEDIUM that contradicts a spec success criterion, OR an empty-input refusal. ESCALATED = auditor read all inputs but cannot form a confident PASS or BLOCK from available evidence; defer to operator (see docs/sdlc/audit/ESCALATION.md). Charter v1.1 §6 zero-deferral applies; §2.1: forced PASS is forbidden — emit ESCALATED instead. Auditor MUST NOT emit PASS while any CRITICAL or HIGH finding is open.

counts.description: Severity histogram. The sum of these counts MUST equal len(findings).

inputs.description: Records of the audit inputs. Optional but recommended for traceability and re-audit reproducibility.

findings.description: All findings in the audit, in the order they were recorded. Each item conforms to schemas/finding.json.

checklist_summary.description: Optional summary of the per-checklist-item verdicts ([x] / [!] / [-]). The full checklist is in the Markdown report; this is just the totals.

wall_clock_seconds.description: Optional. Duration of the audit run end-to-end. Acceptance criterion is <300s for a 500-line diff (skills-roadmap-v1.1.md §2.2).

out_of_scope.description: Optional list of paths or topics deliberately excluded from this audit run, with reasons. Used to make the boundary of the audit explicit (anti-severity-laundering).
